assessment.summary: Multiple 2020 fact-check and analysis sources converge on the calculation that Bloomberg's ~$64.2B net worth exceeded the combined wealth of the bottom 38% of US households (~125 million people), though the bottom-group total varies ($6B vs $11.4B) and the corroboration is not fully independent.

evidence.finding: PolitiFact replicated the calculation and found the bottom 38% of households had about $6 billion in wealth, verifying Bloomberg had more wealth than the bottom 38% combined.
People's Policy Project states Bloomberg's $64.2B net worth is nearly 6 times the $11.4B held by the bottom 38% of households, equal to about 125.7 million people.
Jacobin reports the bottom 38% of US households have a collective net worth of $11 billion versus Bloomberg's $64 billion.
Forbes-sourced net worth of $64.2 billion for Bloomberg is corroborated by a separate outlet.

assertions.assertion: Former mayor of New York, US, Mike Bloomberg owns more wealth than the bottom 125 million Americans.

gaps: No primary Federal Reserve table directly retrieved showing the bottom-38% aggregate net worth.
Bottom-group total varies ($6B vs $11.4B) by methodology, though both support the claim.
S2 and S3 appear to share the same underlying analysis, so they are not fully independent corroboration.
Citation support is uncertain for the Federal Reserve 2020 bulletin URL.
